dedupe_keys.name: optimal hospital capacity management during demand surges optimisation code for patient transfers and surge capacity across hospital systems

description: This repository holds the code for the paper Optimal Hospital Capacity Management During Demand Surges by Felix Parker, Fardin Ganjkhanloo, Diego A. Martínez and Kimia Ghobadi, posted on arXiv in March 2024. The paper addresses how a system of hospitals should manage its capacity when demand surges, and the repository is meant to let others reproduce and reuse its optimisation models. The code is free to download from GitHub under the MIT licence, and the README asks users to cite the paper. Caveats: the README says the authors are still adding their code, so the repository may be incomplete, it does not describe inputs, language or data, and the model details here come only from the paper title, which this record has not read. Coverage is general for hospital systems. Simulation uses: planning surge capacity and load balancing between hospitals during pandemics or mass casualty events. Related records: the HospitalNetwork R package (model-hospitalnetwork-r-package) maps the transfer links between hospitals that such load balancing relies on.
inputs: Hospital capacities and patient demand during a surge
name: Optimal hospital capacity management during demand surges: optimisation code for patient transfers and surge capacity across hospital systems
outputs: Capacity management decisions (as described in the paper)
provider: Felix Parker, Fardin Ganjkhanloo, Diego A. Martínez, Kimia Ghobadi
